news.text: Completed trades: (1) The Eddies sent Brian Robinson Jr. (RB ATL) to Saltese Slamm for rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane (BAL, 69% W7 snaps); (2) Saltese sent Tre Tucker (WR LV) + $5 FAAB to Substation for RJ Harvey (RB DEN). Saltese FAAB now $10, Substation $5, Eddies $34.

Week 8 waivers cleared: The Eddies won Cole Bishop (DB BUF) for $4 (beat Ultron $2, Substation $0), dropping D.J. Reed. Eddies FAAB now $34. League spend: Substation $21 (KC Concepcion, now $0), Hyper $13 (Croskey-Merritt $9, Micah Parsons $4), Doubtpfizer $10 (Kyler Gordon $5, Kaelon Black $3, Nohl Williams $2), Saltese $6, LAB $5, Pocket $3 (Josh Hines-Allen), Newman $3 (Grant Delpit).

Completed trade: The Eddies sent Tyler Warren (TE), Bryce Young (QB) + $11 FAAB to Substation for George Pickens (WR DAL) and Frankie Luvu (LB WAS). Eddies FAAB now $38; projected 193.5 vs Ultron 188.1.

Live check ~2:55 PM PT. W8 Eddies (5-2) @ Ultron (3-4), proj 187.7 to 188.2. FAAB $49. Mon 9:51 PM PT trade: Pocket sent Malik Washington + $10 FAAB to TTAB for Dane Belton. Tue: LAB dropped Tyrone Tracy (IR).
